comments.body: You can also raise jewl trade easily in europe right? Plym/Hamb have Malachite then Copenh has Amber so if you're grinding casting you would easily get yourself to R3 even if you don't have it as favored (or buy coral if you're often in west Euro/Africa). Jewl Trade +2 items are everywhere that would easily allow you to meet requirements for the job quest. Question is, is it worth getting this skill if you can get jewl from Giza/Luxor etc. which is more convenient and faster also with dungeons a lot of cities now have precious stones' price plumbering in the past it's usually spice that has collapsed markets.
